raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Related to #51660. Reject unsupported Guidance tokenizers during request validation, before EngineCore initialization.

Explicit `guidance` requests now validate the tokenizer conversion paths used by `GuidanceBackend`. When `auto` cannot use xgrammar, unsupported tokenizers also exclude Guidance without introducing an automatic fallback to outlines. Existing Mistral behavior, including Tekken support and the non-Tekken fallback, is preserved.

The update preserves current main's JSON validation coverage. A current search for open PRs referencing #51660 found only this PR; related Guidance work addresses structural tags or grammar serialization, rather than this tokenizer validation failure.

## Validation

- `VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/structured_output/test_validation.py -q`: **56 passed**.
- All repository pre-commit hooks for the three changed files passed, including mypy and the Transformers v5 import checks.
- Repeated the 56-test validation suite after updating the tokenizer type names and narrowing the optional structured-output test value.
- `git diff --check` passed.

This change validates requests and does not change model generation, so no model evaluation was run. It does not address the separate xgrammar or outlines failures described in the issue. Full GPU serving was not tested locally.

## AI assistance

AI assistance was used to investigate the failure, update the implementation, resolve the current-main conflict, and run the local checks listed above.

- [x] Purpose and linked issue provided.
- [x] Test plan and results provided.
- [x] Documentation impact considered; no public interface added.

 from vllm.v1.structured_output.backend_types import (
@@ -128,6 +130,37 @@ def process_for_additional_properties(
 
 @dataclass
 class GuidanceBackend(StructuredOutputBackend):
+    @staticmethod
+    def is_tokenizer_supported(tokenizer: TokenizerLike) -> bool:
+        """Check if tokenizer is supported by guidance backend.
+
+        TODO(arpera):
+        guidance backend does NOT support some types of tokenizers
+        so, we MUST verify tokenizer before using guidance
+        The problem is that guidance API does not provide
+        a way to validate tokenizer before building LLTokenizer
+        So, we have to do it manually here in vLLM.
+        This is ofcourse very bad, we duplicate complex logic
+        that can change arbitrary in future.
+        Our check here is based on guidance source code
+        on function `from_tokenizer` implementation:
+        https://github.com/guidance-ai/llguidance/blob/main/python/llguidance/hf.py#L29-L47
+        If you want to contribute to vLLM, please, add to llguidance
+        API function to implement this check there.
+        In that case we will remove this check from vLLM.
+        That kind of work is really appreciated!
+        """
+        if is_mistral_tokenizer(tokenizer):
+            return tokenizer.is_tekken
+        # PreTrainedTokenizerFast is the same as TokenizersBackend
+        return isinstance(tokenizer, TokenizersBackend)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _build_ll_tokenizer(tokenizer: TokenizerLike, vocab_size: int) -> Any:
+        if is_mistral_tokenizer(tokenizer):
+            return tokenizer.llg_tokenizer
+        return llguidance_hf.from_tokenizer(tokenizer, max(vocab_size, len(tokenizer)))
+
